notes.text: - **INS Sarvekshak:** hydrographic survey ship – **first Indian Navy ship to install a solar power system** (Green Initiative, February 2017); **18 flexible panels of 300 W** each.

exam: APPSC
q:
Read the following statements regarding India's SHAKTI-based aerospace semiconductor chip in February 2025 and choose the correct option from the below.
Statement 1: In February 2025, IIT Delhi and ISRO jointly developed and booted an indigenous SHAKTI-based aerospace-grade semiconductor chip. Statement 2: The chip is based on the open-source RISC-V Instruction Set Architecture under the DIRV initiative of MeitY.
explanation: The Feb 2025 SHAKTI-based aerospace chip (IRIS) was developed and booted by IIT Madras with ISRO – not IIT Delhi – so Statement 1 is wrong. It is built on the open-source RISC-V ISA, the basis of MeitY's DIR-V programme, so Statement 2 is right.

notes.text: - Lead-up: regional AI conferences in 8 States (Oct 2025-Jan 2026); 700+ global proposals; AI Compendium released.

exam: APPSC Group-2 PYQ
q: Which company makes the fighter aircraft 'Rafale'?
explanation: The Rafale is made by France's Dassault Aviation (India: 36 in service, 114 more approved in 2026). Lockheed Martin and Northrop Grumman are US firms; Hawker Beechcraft made trainers/business aircraft.

notes.text: - Came after **PSLV-C61/EOS-09 failed in May 2025** (also the 3rd stage) – **two PSLV failures in a row**; ISRO staff unions raised outsourcing under the 2023 Space Policy.

exam: APPSC Forest Beat Officer & Assistant Beat Officer (Mains) P
q: Which Indian Air Force Officer, selected for ISRO's Gaganyaan Mission, became the first Indian astronaut to travel to the International Space Station (ISS) aboard the Axiom Mission 4 in 2025?
explanation: Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla (IAF, Gaganyaan astronaut-designate) flew as Pilot of Axiom-4 (June 2025) and became the first Indian on the ISS. Rakesh Sharma flew Soyuz T-11 (1984) but never went to the ISS; Kalpana Chawla and Sunita Williams were NASA astronauts.

notes.text: - Shukla = **first Indian on the ISS** and **first Indian in space in 40 years** – after **Rakesh Sharma (Soyuz T-11, 1984)**.

q: After 31 years of service, INS Anjadip, the last Petya class warship, was decommissioned on December 13, 2003 at Visakhapatnam. Who was its last Commanding Officer?
explanation: The last Commanding Officer of INS Anjadip was Cdr Siddhartha Panda, who handed the ship's ensign box to the FOC-in-C at the 13 Dec 2003 decommissioning at Visakhapatnam. Vice Adm O.P. Bansal was that FOC-in-C (Eastern Naval Command) – the receiving C-in-C, not the CO (official key: O.P. Bansal).

q: Digiboxx an alternative to google drive, provides 20 GB of free cloud storage was launched by
explanation: DigiBoxx, India's home-grown cloud-storage alternative to Google Drive with 20 GB free, was launched by NITI Aayog (CEO Amitabh Kant) in December 2020, though the app itself was built by a private start-up. Facebook, C-DAC and Amazon are wrong.
